prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on growth: growth scores 86 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also in its favour: profit grew 41% compared with a year earlier; sales grew 29% compared with a year earlier; and profit covers interest costs 5.5 times over. Other areas on this side: the balance sheet, risk, the recent price trend.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 10.4% lower than a year ago. Also against it: over the past year the share did 8.6 percentage points worse than the Nifty 50; quality scores only 33 of 100 against the comparison pool; and value scores only 34 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: the quality of the business, what the price asks for the earnings.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 7 points in favour and 4 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 52 of 100. The side that carries most weight is growth. That gives an educational rating of Overweight with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
